cc:Work.dc:description: Directional CLIP (higher) versus preservation LPIPS (lower). Separate R84 dose and R85 independent populations. CLIP n=10/40; LPIPS n=8/33 because empty preservation masks are excluded. Original source-equal means and marginal 95% bootstrap intervals, no joint interval or frontier estimation. Only R84 CORR lambda15/25/35 joined. R85 RFEDIT seed0 only.
